# 📝 Pull Request Template

## Description

Please provide a summary of the changes made in this PR.

- What issue does it solve?
- Any new features or improvements?
- What problems does it address?

---

## Type of Change

Select the relevant type of change for this PR.

- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change)
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change)
- [ ] 🔄 Refactor (code changes without feature or bug)
- [ ] ⚠️ Breaking change (feature/fix that breaks compatibility)

---

## Related Issue

Link the related issue or task:

Closes #<issue-number>

---

## How Has This Been Tested?

Provide details about the testing you performed on the PR changes.

- [ ] Unit tests
- [ ] Integration tests
- [ ] Manually tested on desktop or mobile
- [ ] Checked for UI/UX consistency

---

## Screenshots (if applicable)

Provide screenshots of the new feature or bug fix if it's visual:

| Platform | Screenshot                    |
| -------- | ----------------------------- |
| Desktop  | <img src="URL" width="1000"/> |
| Mobile   | <img src="URL" width="300"/>  |

---

## Additional Notes

Add any additional information about the changes here.
